_doc: Claude account split (auth-split PR2). accounts: configDir selects a Claude login directory (~ expands to the home directory); it must exist, be a directory, and contain a .claude.json checked only with stat, never read. Invalid directories refuse launch; provision the login directory before retrying. Keychain fields select a long-lived token (type oauth -> CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, apikey -> ANTHROPIC_API_KEY); no secrets live in this file. daemons: launchd label (XPC_SERVICE_NAME) -> account id; unknown mapped accounts refuse. routing.accountB must be exactly true to apply mappings to b (default false); otherwise those mappings are ignored. Other accounts route independently of routing.accountB and enforce. enforce only controls unmapped com.we.* / com.plateau.* labels: they refuse only when enforce is exactly true and "*" is "refuse". Interactive and non-launchd sessions always resolve to none.
